name: Amur Stonechat
rangeDescription: Eastern siberia to japan and korea; winters to southern china and indochina
description: A chunky little bird found in a wide variety of open landscapes, often sitting on exposed perches. Breeding male has a black head, a broad white half-collar, mostly rusty-red underparts, and a white undertail and rump.

name: Pied Thrush
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern india from nepal to assam; winters to sri lanka
description: Slender, ground-dwelling thrush. Male is breathtakingly decked out in black and white.

name: White-lored Oriole
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (montane forest of luzon)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland forest and edge in the lowlands and lower mountains on Luzon. Overall yellow in color, slightly darker on the wings and tail, with a reddish bill and a white mark between the bill and the brown eye.

name: Madeira Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Madeira
description: Dapper little finch endemic to Madeira, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from forests to farmlands. Handsome, brightly colored male has a blue-grayish cowl, pale orangish face and breast, and a black-and-white wing pattern (colors muted in winter).

name: Large Lifou White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest of lifou island (loyalty islands)
description: A bizarre, large and heavy-billed white-eye that is notably distinctive among a group of birds famed for being homogeneous. Note gray plumage overall contrasting with olive head and wings.

name: Gray-backed Hawk
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western ecuador and adjacent northwestern peru
description: An endangered raptor found only in western Ecuador and immediately adjacent parts of Peru. It has white underparts, dark gray back and wings, and gray streaks on the head.

name: Mariana Crow
rangeDescription: Rota (southern northern mariana islands) and guam (where extinct; southern mariana islands, western micronesia)
description: Known to the Chamorro as the Åga, Mariana Crow is a small, entirely black crow with a dark blue gloss on the head and wings when seen well. Bases of body feathers are white, giving a ragged appearance.

name: Scarlet-horned Manakin
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela, western guyana, and far northern brazil
description: Small, chunky bird; males are black with a crested red head. Females are olive-green, paler below, with a short crest.

name: Green-faced Parrotfinch
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (luzon and negros)
description: A small bird of montane forest and scrub. Feeds on seeding bamboo.

name: Muisca Antpitta
rangeDescription: Andes of venezuela (táchira) and eastern andes of colombia southward to cundinamarca and western meta (but absent from the west slope in the iguaque massif in boyacá and far southwestern santander)
description: Plump bird with long legs and a short tail that ranges in the eastern Andes of Colombia, barely reaching over the border into Venezuela. Plumage is chestnut brown with an orange tinge to the breast and slightly paler belly; sometimes shows a faint mustache streak.

name: Sickle-billed Vanga
rangeDescription: Savanna and mangroves of western and northern madagascar
description: Huge black-and-white vanga with a long curved bill. Juveniles have shorter bills.

name: Gray-crested Finch
rangeDescription: Arid andes of southeastern bolivia and northwestern argentina (jujuy and salta)
description: Small, mostly terrestrial finch-like tanager of dry intermontane valleys from central Bolivia to NW Argentina. Plain gray plumage and erect crest distinctive.

name: Corsican Finch
rangeDescription: Corsica and sardinia
description: Endemic to the islands of Corsica and Sardinia where it occurs in open lowland scrub to montane dry scrub and open to semiopen coniferous forests. A small finch with a bright yellow face and breast and a brown streaky back.

name: Red-crested Pochard
rangeDescription: Breeds from europe (iberian peninsula northward to southern denmark and poland) eastward to central asia (northwestern china and western mongolia); somewhat local in europe, more widespread to east; resident in southwestern europe; elsewhere, winters from eastern mediterranean eastward to northern india, south-central china, and northern myanmar
description: A diving duck of larger lakes and reservoirs, especially with fringing reeds. Male striking and unmistakable with large, rounded, rusty-orange head, long red bill, and black breast.

name: Sulu Hornbill
rangeDescription: Sulu archipelago (jolo, tawitawi, and sanga sanga)
description: A large bird of lowland and montane forest on the Sulu Islands, although probably only remaining on Tawi-Tawi. Feeds particularly on fig trees.

name: Black-capped Pygmy-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of costa rica to western colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Tiny short-tailed flycatcher, one of the smallest songbirds in the world. Similar shape and size to a golf ball.

name: Eurasian Siskin
rangeDescription: Northern palearctic; winters mediterranean region, china, and ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: Small yellowish finch with prominent wingbars. Male is attractive and distinctive, with a yellow face and breast offset by a black cap and small chin patch.

name: Guianan Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: The guianas (guyana, suriname, and french guiana) southward to the amazon river
description: Inconspicuous and rarely seen bird of rainforest canopy. Small and slender with a long tail; mostly dark gray with a broken white eyering, white belly, and white outer tail feathers.

name: Kalao Blue Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Kalao island (flores sea)
description: A recently split species from Kalao island in Indonesia. Deep blue upperparts with slightly paler brow, black chin and sides to the face, orange belly, and white throat.

name: Violet-chested Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela and coastal cordillera eastward to miranda
description: Attractive large hummingbird, green and long billed with an iridescent violet patch on chest (male), orange wing patch, and white tipped tail. Both sexes have buff scaling on underparts; female has a white moustache and buffy scaled throat and chest.
